PreToolUse.bash:
if command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1; then output=$(rtk hook copilot) && { printf '%s
' "$output"; exit 0; }; fi; printf 'RTK unavailable or hook failed; allowing tool unchanged
' >&2; printf '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}
'
PreToolUse.powershell: if (Get-Command rtk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $output = & rtk hook copilot; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $output; exit 0 } }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RTK unavailable or hook failed; allowing tool unchanged'); '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}'
